name: Matt Haig
bio: British author known for exploring life's big questions through imaginative storytelling. His works blend philosophical depth with accessible prose.

name: Andy Weir
bio: Science fiction author celebrated for technical accuracy and humor. Known for writing about ordinary people in extraordinary situations.

name: James Clear
bio: Author and entrepreneur focused on habits, systems, and human performance. His research-driven approach has helped millions improve their lives.

name: Koyoharu Gotouge
bio: Japanese manga artist known for creating Demon Slayer. Gotouge's work combines stunning artwork with compelling storytelling.

name: Chugong
bio: Korean author behind the hit manhwa Solo Leveling. Known for innovative world-building and character development in the webtoon industry.

name: F. Scott Fitzgerald
bio: American author and novelist of the Jazz Age. Fitzgerald's works capture the complexity and decadence of the 1920s era.

name: Daniel Goleman
bio: Psychologist and author who popularized the concept of emotional intelligence. His research has shaped modern understanding of human potential.

name: Gege Akutami
bio: Japanese manga artist creating Jujutsu Kaisen. Known for intricate plot design and stylish character artistry.

name: Frank Herbert
bio: Science fiction author who created Dune, one of the most influential science fiction novels ever written.

name: Sun Tzu
bio: Ancient Chinese military strategist whose work 'The Art of War' remains relevant after over 2,000 years.
